messages.subject: International Mining Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Stakeholder Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Stokes,

Opal Consulting Group's work across mining and resources leadership makes this a relevant introduction for senior international mandates.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a major gold-mining operation.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership roles where mining strategy, regulatory credibility, stakeholder confidence and responsible development intersect. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate appointments across the GCC, APAC and wider global resources markets.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for appropriate current or future searches.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
